learnings: 2026-09-25 reels: Seedance 2.0 breaks on hands, feet and full bodies; tight chest-up selfie framing with hands/phone out of frame removed hand errors.
2026-09-25 reels: set clip length = voice length rounded up; extra seconds make the mouth keep moving after the line.
2026-09-25 reels: models invent logos on plain jackets; say 'completely plain, no text, letters, logo or badge' for every garment.

2026-09-25 QC: a single vision model invents defects (Gemini reported the same six-finger collar touch on two different takes); require a second describing model (Qwen 3.6) to confirm a blocker before paying for a re-render.
2026-09-25 kling-lipsync repair is cheap (17 credits/s) and fixes sync, but drops the ambient sound (voice only).
sonilo-video-sfx-mix replaced the voice in a test; generate ambience separately (sonilo-video-sfx, video length) and overlay it in a stitch.
Video-matched ambience picks up on-screen props (paper bag rustle too loud on the market clip): tell it 'nothing close to the microphone'.

Voice master = the clip the user likes; check every other reel by stitching it after the master and asking a listener model for a same-speaker score, then re-roll the TTS take until MATCH. A take longer than the clip gets its last word cut.

Budget rule (user feedback 2026-09-25): quote credits before each pass, test one clip before a batch, and stop and ask before going past the quote. Fix timing at the source (render with the final voice) instead of re-syncing lips over old footage.

2026-09-26: timed prompt method (TIMING line + SHOT BREAKDOWN sized to the VO, closed-mouth tail, native render with the final VO) passed the user's visual check on clip 8; use it for every talking clip.
